title: Pressure Washing in Hawthorne, FL | Soft Wash Too
description: Pressure washing and soft washing in Hawthorne, FL for mildewed siding, pollen-coated walls, drives, decks, and roofs. Right pressure for each surface.
h1: Pressure Washing and Soft Washing in Hawthorne, FL
heroIntro: Green siding on the shady side of the house, yellow pollen film every spring, and black streaks on the driveway: we match the cleaning method to the surface so nothing gets etched or forced full of water.

sections.h2: Lake country grows things on houses
body: Between the lakes, the tree canopy, and months of humidity above 75 percent, Hawthorne siding stays damp long enough for mildew and algae to settle in. North walls, eaves, and anything under oaks take the worst of it. Add spring pollen and the dirt that splashes up onto foundations in every storm, and most homes here benefit from a wash every year or two whether or not they are due for paint. Pressure washing in Hawthorne, FL is often the cheapest way to make a house look years younger. See how it fits into our wider Hawthorne work.

Not every surface should see high pressure. Painted siding, stucco, screens, and roofs get a soft wash: a low-pressure application of cleaning solution that kills the growth at the root, followed by a gentle rinse. Concrete drives, walks, and pool decks can take higher pressure with a surface cleaner that keeps the pattern even. Wood decks and fences get a middle approach that lifts grime without raising the grain.
Our guide to cleaning Florida pollen stains explains why yellow film sometimes comes back after a plain rinse.
bullets: Eaves, soffits, and gutters' outer faces

body: If you are planning to repaint, the wash is not optional. Paint applied over mildew or chalk will lift, and new coatings can trap living growth underneath. Before any exterior repaint in Hawthorne, our crews wash, treat mildew, and let the walls dry fully before a scraper or brush touches them. When washing is part of a paint job, it appears as its own line on the estimate.

There is no fixed schedule, but a few signs say it is time: a green or black haze on the north wall, streaks running down from the gutters, a slick film on the shady part of the walkway, or a hand that comes away chalky after you brush the siding. Homes under heavy canopy near the lakes usually need it more often than open lots along SR-20. A regular wash also makes the next repaint cheaper, because there is less buildup to strip before prep.

sections.h2: Protecting what is around the house
body: Plants are pre-wet and rinsed after the cleaning solution goes on, outlets and fixtures are covered, and windows are rinsed down at the end. Downspouts are aimed away from beds where runoff would collect. If your siding is showing signs of moisture damage behind the surface, our article on hidden siding moisture damage lists what to look for, and our main pressure washing service page covers the rest.

faqs.q: Will pressure washing damage my siding?
faqs.a: Not when the method fits the surface. Painted siding and stucco are soft-washed at low pressure; only hard surfaces like concrete get high pressure.

faqs.q: Do you clean roofs in Hawthorne?
faqs.a: Yes, using a soft wash only. High pressure can strip granules and damage shingles.

faqs.q: How soon can you paint after washing?
faqs.a: Once the surface is fully dry. On a humid Hawthorne day that can take longer than people expect, so we check moisture before painting rather than going by the clock.
